name: Bog of Cullen
lore: The Bog of Cullen: Siopa and Alainn Bin on the edges of a bog where the lights walk at night. The Glimmer has taken the Gemstone Tower in the middle of it, Cliodna's old tower, and the gems in its walls send its lights out over the water. The siabra guide them; the Order of the Azure has come down the north road to burn the bog; and Badb, the battle-crow, has settled on her mound to feed on the war.

chains.title: The Siabra Waterwalkers
chains.hint: Siabra waterwalkers are crossing the marches with lights on poles...

stages.name: Clear Siabra Camp
stages.objective: Clear the siabra camp
stages.announce: The siabra waterwalkers are out on the causeway, hanging new lights on the poles for the Glimmer. Break them before the road of lights is finished.
stages.success: You have cleared the siabra camp. The Siabra Marsh-Lord comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the siabra camp. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: The Siabra Marsh-Lord
stages.objective: Defeat the Siabra Marsh-Lord
stages.announce: The Siabra Marsh-Lord stands at the siabra camp. Bring friends.
stages.success: The Siabra Marsh-Lord falls. The way is safe again.
stages.fail: The Siabra Marsh-Lord slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Siabra Waterwalkers Hold the Road to Siopa
stages.objective: Drive the siabra waterwalkers off the road to Siopa
stages.announce: With The Siabra Waterwalkers lost, the siabra waterwalkers have spread down onto the road to Siopa and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The siabra waterwalkers are gone from the road to Siopa. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Cormac, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Cormac has come out to set the road to Siopa right. The siabra waterwalkers are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road to Siopa is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The siabra waterwalkers break and scatter. The road to Siopa is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Cormac falls, and the siabra waterwalkers take the road back.

chains.title: The Bog Creepers
chains.hint: Something stirs under the turf-cutters' road...

stages.name: Protect Tomas the Peat-Cutter
stages.objective: Protect Tomas the Peat-Cutter, who is loading his peat cart
stages.announce: Ciaran has cut too deep into the bog, and what was under the peat is crawling out. Hold it off while he loads his cart.
stages.success: "That's done," says Tomas the Peat-Cutter. "They came from over there - let's finish this."
stages.fail: Tomas the Peat-Cutter falls. The attackers are left to do as they please - for now.

stages.name: Clear Peat Cuttings
stages.objective: Clear the peat cuttings
stages.announce: They came from the peat cuttings. Follow them back and clear it out.
stages.success: You have cleared the peat cuttings. The Cullen Bog-Horror comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the peat cuttings. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: The Cullen Bog-Horror
stages.objective: Defeat the Cullen Bog-Horror
stages.announce: The Cullen Bog-Horror stands at the peat cuttings. Bring friends.
stages.success: The Cullen Bog-Horror falls. The way is safe again.
stages.fail: The Cullen Bog-Horror slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Bog Creepers Hold the Road to Siopa
stages.objective: Drive the bog creepers off the road to Siopa
stages.announce: With The Bog Creepers lost, the bog creepers have spread down onto the road to Siopa and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The bog creepers are gone from the road to Siopa. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Aine, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Aine has come out to set the road to Siopa right. The bog creepers are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road to Siopa is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The bog creepers break and scatter. The road to Siopa is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Aine falls, and the bog creepers take the road back.

chains.title: The Siabra Wayguards
chains.hint: Sentinel Una is looking for help in Siopa.

giver.name: Sentinel Una
giver.greet: The siabra have set a wayguard post on our road and let their hounds loose on anyone who passes. We're going to clear it. Will you come? Say when you're [ready].
giver.reply: Good. Stay close - they will have watchers out. With me!
giver.busy: We've only just come back. Give my people a while to rest, then find me again.

stages.name: The Road to Wayguard Post
stages.objective: Go with Sentinel Una to the wayguard post
stages.announce: Sentinel Una leads the Clann of Alainn Bin out to the siabra wayguard post.
stages.success: Sentinel Una reaches the wayguard post. "There they are. Clear them out!"
stages.fail: Sentinel Una falls on the road. The others carry the body home.

stages.name: Clear Wayguard Post
stages.objective: Clear the wayguard post
stages.announce: Clear the wayguard post!
stages.success: You have cleared the wayguard post. Wayguard Captain Fiach comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the wayguard post. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: Wayguard Captain Fiach
stages.objective: Defeat Wayguard Captain Fiach
stages.announce: Wayguard Captain Fiach stands at the wayguard post. Bring friends.
stages.success: Wayguard Captain Fiach falls. Siopa will hear of this in the taverns tonight.
stages.fail: Wayguard Captain Fiach slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Siabra Wayguards Hold the Road to Siopa
stages.objective: Drive the siabra wayguards off the road to Siopa
stages.announce: With The Siabra Wayguards lost, the siabra wayguards have spread down onto the road to Siopa and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The siabra wayguards are gone from the road to Siopa. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Cormac, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Cormac has come out to set the road to Siopa right. The siabra wayguards are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road to Siopa is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The siabra wayguards break and scatter. The road to Siopa is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Cormac falls, and the siabra wayguards take the road back.

chains.title: The Siabra Raiders
chains.hint: Siabra raiders have dug in on the north-west marches...

stages.name: Clear Raiders' Camp
stages.objective: Clear the raiders' camp
stages.announce: Siabra raiders have made a camp on the bog road and rob every traveller between Siopa and Alainn Bin. Clear it.
stages.success: You have cleared the raiders' camp. The Mirelord comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the raiders' camp. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: The Mirelord
stages.objective: Defeat the Mirelord
stages.announce: The Mirelord stands at the raiders' camp. Bring friends.
stages.success: The Mirelord falls. The way is safe again.
stages.fail: The Mirelord slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Siabra Raiders Hold the Road to Siopa
stages.objective: Drive the siabra raiders off the road to Siopa
stages.announce: With The Siabra Raiders lost, the siabra raiders have spread down onto the road to Siopa and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The siabra raiders are gone from the road to Siopa. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Ruadh, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Ruadh has come out to set the road to Siopa right. The siabra raiders are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road to Siopa is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The siabra raiders break and scatter. The road to Siopa is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Ruadh falls, and the siabra raiders take the road back.

chains.title: Wisp-Night
chains.hint: Lamplighter Nessa is gathering travellers in Siopa for the night road to Alainn Bin.

giver.name: Lamplighter Nessa
giver.greet: Travellers for Alainn Bin, and the bog-lights out tonight. They lead you off the path, and the path is all there is out there. Walk with us? Say when you're [ready].
giver.reply: Keep to my lamp. Whatever lights you see, they are not mine.

stages.name: The Night Road
stages.objective: Walk with Lamplighter Nessa and the travellers from Siopa to Alainn Bin
stages.announce: Lamplighter Nessa leads the travellers out of Siopa onto the night road. The bog-lights are already moving.

ambushes.say: Lights - off the path! Don't follow them!
Wraiths on the keening ground - keep moving!

stages.success: The travellers come in under Alainn Bin's gate lamps. Nessa counts them twice.
stages.fail: Nessa's lamp goes out on the bog.

chains.title: The Keen
chains.hint: The banshee is keening - and the wraiths are rising on the keening ground...

stages.name: The Gate
stages.objective: Keep Keener Brid alive at Alainn Bin's north gate while she keens the dead down
stages.announce: The banshee of Cullen is keening, and the drowned dead of the bog are rising and coming for Alainn Bin. Keener Brid stands at the north gate to keen them back down - keep them off her!
stages.thanks: "They're down. Back in the bog where they belong. Thank you."
stages.success: The dead sink back into the bog - all but one, a false banshee, lit from inside.
stages.fail: The gate falls. The town's people stay indoors until dawn.

stages.name: the Glass Keener
stages.objective: Defeat the Glass Keener
stages.announce: The Glass Keener comes up the road, keening in a voice like breaking glass. Bring friends.
stages.success: The Glass Keener shatters. The true keen goes on, far off, and then stops.
stages.fail: The Glass Keener goes back into the dark.

chains.title: The Azure March
chains.hint: Blue banners on the north road - an Azure column is coming down with torches...

stages.name: The Torch-Bearers
stages.objective: Stop the Azure column before its torch-bearer reaches the peat
stages.announce: An Azure column is marching down the north road with torches for the peat. If the torch-bearer reaches the cuttings, the bog burns underground for a year. Stop him!
stages.success: The torch-bearer falls, and his torch hisses out in the bog-water.
stages.fail: The torch goes into the peat. Smoke rises from the cuttings.

stages.name: Column-Captain Sorlaith
stages.objective: Defeat Column-Captain Sorlaith
stages.announce: The column's captain comes on alone. 'Burn it, or the Glimmer has it. There is no third way.' Bring friends.

boss.name: Column-Captain Sorlaith
boss.guild: of the Order of the Azure

stages.success: Sorlaith falls. The column breaks and runs back up the north road.
stages.fail: Sorlaith marches on toward the cuttings.

stages.name: The Cuttings Burn
stages.objective: Drive the Azure out of the burning cuttings
stages.announce: The Azure hold the turf-cutters' camp and the peat is smouldering under it. Drive them out so the cutters can flood the fire!
stages.success: The Azure are gone. The turf-cutters flood the burning peat.

chains.title: The Cullen Gold
chains.hint: The turf-cutters have struck gold in the far cuttings - and the siabra have heard...

stages.name: The Hoard
stages.objective: Keep Tomas the Peat-Cutter alive while he lifts the hoard
stages.announce: Tomas the Peat-Cutter has found another hoard in the far cuttings - collars, cups, a king's ransom of old gold. The siabra are coming for it. Keep them off him!
stages.thanks: "Got it all. Every piece. It glows, you know - it never used to."
stages.success: The hoard is out of the turf. The siabra's gold-reaver comes for it himself.
stages.fail: The siabra carry the gold off toward the tower.

stages.name: the Gold-Reaver
stages.objective: Defeat the siabra Gold-Reaver
stages.announce: The siabra Gold-Reaver wades out of the bog with a sack for the hoard. Bring friends.
stages.success: The Gold-Reaver falls. His sack spills old gold over the turf.
stages.fail: The Gold-Reaver gets away with the hoard.

chains.title: The Crow's Field
chains.hint: Blue banners and siabra spears on the open bog - and a great crow circling...

stages.name: The Battle on the Bog
stages.objective: Break the battle between the Azure and the siabra
stages.announce: An Azure column has run into a siabra war band on the open bog by the tower, and they're killing each other. Whoever wins comes for Alainn Bin next - break them both.
stages.success: Both sides reel back from each other - and something huge and black drops out of the sky onto the field.
stages.fail: The battle burns on until the bog is red.

stages.name: Badb's Shade
stages.objective: Drive off Badb's Shade
stages.announce: Badb's shade comes down on the dead - a crow as big as a horse. She's here to feed, and you're still standing. Bring friends.
stages.success: Badb's shade lifts off the field with a scream like a war-horn and flies back to her mound.
stages.fail: Badb's shade feeds.

chains.title: Storm the Gemstone Tower
chains.hint: The Keeners are gathering a war band on the bog south-east of the Gemstone Tower.

giver.name: Keener-Captain Muadhnait
giver.greet: The Glimmer holds the Gemstone Tower and its gems light the whole bog for it. Five at least - bots and all - and when you're ready, say [put out the tower].
giver.reply: Across the causeway, then the gems, then whatever keeps them. Keep together - the lights pull at you!
giver.thanks: The tower is dark. The bog is ours.
giver.regret: Back! Back to the firm ground! We'll come again.

stages.name: The Causeway
stages.objective: Break the Glimmer's guard at the foot of the tower
stages.announce: Onto the tower's causeway! Ghouls and wards on every step - clear the way to the gems!
stages.success: The causeway's clear. Above, the three great gems blaze in the walls.
stages.fail: The war band is driven back onto the bog.

stages.name: The Three Gems
stages.objective: Hold all three great gems at once while the Keeners break them
stages.announce: The three great gems - green, white and red. Stand at all three at once and the Keeners can keen them dark!
stages.success: The gems go dark one by one - and the Gem-Warden comes down out of the tower.
stages.fail: The gems blaze on. The war band falls back.

stages.name: the Gem-Warden
stages.objective: Defeat the Gem-Warden of the tower
stages.announce: The Gem-Warden, a knight of the Glimmer in armour of light: 'The King's eye does not close.'
stages.success: The Gem-Warden falls, and the Gemstone Tower goes dark. The Keeners light their own lamp at its top.
stages.fail: The Gem-Warden drives the war band out of the tower.

chains.title: The Light Comes Back
chains.hint: The bog-lights are gathering round the dark tower - the Glimmer is coming back for it!

stages.name: The Keeners' Lamp
stages.objective: Keep Lamp-Keeper Eimear alive at the top of the tower
stages.announce: Every light on the bog is coming for the tower at once. Hold the Keeners' lamp!
stages.success: The first rush breaks - and a shape of light walks out of the bog to the tower door.
stages.fail: The lamp goes out, and the gems light again.

stages.name: the Returning Light
stages.objective: Defeat the Returning Light
stages.announce: The Returning Light, Cuuldurach's own servant, come to relight his eye: 'This tower is the King's.'
stages.success: The Returning Light breaks. The tower stays dark - for now.
stages.fail: The gems blaze again. The tower is the Glimmer's.

siege.name: the Gemstone Tower
siege.open_text: Hear me! The Keeners of Cullen mean to put out the Gemstone Tower! Keener-Captain Muadhnait waits on the bog south-east of it. If no one leads within the half-hour, the Keeners go without you.
siege.taken_text: The Gemstone Tower is dark! The Keeners have lit their own lamp at its top - go and see.
siege.repelled_text: The attack on the Gemstone Tower has been thrown back. The bog-lights grow bolder.
siege.raid_text: The bog-lights are gathering round the dark tower: the Glimmer is coming back for it!
siege.held_text: The light is driven off. The tower stays dark.
siege.fall_text: The Gemstone Tower has fallen. Its gems blaze again, and the Keeners must rebuild their resolve.
siege.carry_text: The Keeners lead you across the bog at a run.
siege.carried_cry: The war band wouldn't wait any longer - the Keeners have stormed {0}!

camp_npcs.name: Tower-Quartermaster Fionnuala
camp_npcs.greet: Tower-only stock, for those who put out the gems and those who keep the lamp.

camp_npcs.name: Lamp-Keeper Eimear
camp_npcs.greet: The Keeners' lamp. As long as it burns, the gems stay dark.
camp_npcs.idle: Watch the bog at night. When the lights all turn toward the tower at once, they're coming.

camp_npcs.name: freed turf-cutter
camp_npcs.idle: They had us carrying gems up the tower steps. Every night. I can still see the light when I close my eyes.
